subject: Insurance
title: The Texas Winter Storm
description: One-minute skill: The Texas Winter Storm.

hook.text: In February 2021, a polar vortex froze Texas for days. Pipes burst in millions of homes.

buildup.text: Texas's power grid collapsed. Temperatures hit single digits. Homes without heat saw indoor pipes freeze and explode.

discovery.text: Water damage claims flooded insurers. The average claim was $10,000-$20,000. Some homes had six-figure repair bills.

twist.text: Many policies had freeze exclusions or high weather-related deductibles.

climax.text: Texas proved that climate disasters don't just mean hurricanes.

punchline.text: Frozen pipes, $15 billion in claims. Texas wasn't insured for its own winter.

quiz.question: Why were many Texans underinsured during the 2021 winter storm?
options: Policies had weather-related exclusions or high deductibles
